hero.title: An old-world café *in North Augusta*
hero.lede: Counter Culture coffee with syrups made in-house, uncommon wines, regional beers and craft cocktails in Jackson Square, with a courtyard for events and a 1999 Land Rover that brings the espresso bar to you.

facts.label: Every syrup, made by our baristas

sections.title: Coffee first, *then a glass of wine*

items.title: Counter Culture coffee
items.text: From Durham, North Carolina, a leader in sustainable sourcing, in our café or to go.

items.title: Signature lattes
items.text: Flavored coffees inspired by North Augusta, with syrups our baristas make in-house.

items.title: Uncommon wines
items.text: Sourced from around the world, for the most unusual affordable selection in the CSRA.

items.title: Regional craft beer
items.text: A rotating, regionally focused list, and we love to show off the artistic cans.

items.title: Craft cocktails
items.text: Cocktails at the bar in the evening; ask your bartender what’s new.

items.title: Light lunch & pastries
items.text: Lunch on weekdays from 11 to 2; wraps, muffins, avocado toast and pastries every day.

sections.title: Come for the coffee, *stay to chat*

image.alt: A barista pouring steamed milk into a to-go cup at the espresso machine

body: Cavalier’s Coffeehouse, or “Cav’s,” brings the atmosphere of an old-world café to North Augusta. Quality is always the priority, and we love to talk about what’s in the cup.
Stop in for an early espresso, a light lunch, or a glass of wine with friends after work. Not sure what to try? Ask your barista or bartender.

items.title: Tell us your plans
items.text: Our 1999 Defender 110 serves gatherings of 30 or more: staff appreciation, weddings and community events.

items.title: We review the details
items.text: We look at your date, place and guest count, and plan the drinks around them.

items.title: Confirm your expedition
items.text: We arrive and pour freshly made coffee, one cup at a time.

sections.title: An old-world café *for your event*
sections.intro: An indoor beer and wine bar, and an outdoor courtyard with an activities lawn and a stage. We hold beer, wine and liquor permits, offer light catering on site, and work with catering partners.

columns.title: Spaces
items: A pergola table or a few tables

columns.title: Also for
items: A reply usually the same business day

items.a: A light lunch on weekdays from 11 to 2, and wraps, muffins, avocado toast and pastries every day. Call to ask what’s available today.
In Jackson Square, 336 Georgia Avenue, Suite 107, in North Augusta.

items.q: Can the Defender come to my event?
items.a: Yes, for gatherings of 30 or more. Call or email to check your date.
Email manager@cavscoffee.com to join the Cav’s team.

sections.title: Planning a gathering?
sections.text: Book the café, the courtyard or the Defender.
